'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Chris Fanchi LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Fanchi]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Auto loss
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
